messages:
Linh: quick heads-up — KMS/HSM integration milestone is slipping. Auditors expect evidence for key rotation runbook, KMS export logs, and HSM attestation by 2026-03-22. Who can own which piece?
Marta: I can own the runbook + a short walkthru doc. ETA: EOD Tue 2026-03-19.
Kevin: I can take export logs. Do auditors want CSV or JSON? Also will need retention/config snapshot.
Linh: they historically prefer signed CSVs + an S3 presigned link for large exports. retention proof = lifecycle policy screenshot + config snapshot.
Nina: small blocker — staging log ingest missed 2026-02-14 -> 2026-02-16 window. Ops, can we backfill?
ops-oncall: oncall here — we can run a backfill but need a maintenance window. Proposed: Tue 2026-03-19 02:00-03:30 PT. Backfill command will be:```bash
python tools/backfill_logs.py --start 2026-02-14 --end 2026-02-16 --env staging
```
Sam: FYI linked the PR that fixed the pipeline bug: https://github.com/redwood-inference/log-pipeline/pull/412 — I can review + merge today if ops gives the go-ahead.
security-bot: Reminder — evidence checklist updated: https://confluence.internal.redwood/sec/kms-evidence. Please tag uploads with `audit_run:2026_Q1`.
Marta: quick question on attestation: do we need the HSM vendor attestation letter, or is an internal attestation acceptable for fieldwork?
Linh: vendor letter is preferred. If vendor can't provide in time, internal attestation + expected vendor delivery date is acceptable. Mark the item as "in progress" in the checklist and add ETA.
Kevin: I'll prepare the CSV sample + retention snapshot and upload to the evidence bucket. Will attach ACL screenshot too.
Sam: PR merged to staging. @ops-oncall you should be good to kick the backfill.
ops-oncall: Scheduled backfill for Tue 2026-03-19 02:00-03:30 PT. Will post runbook excerpt and job logs to the evidence bucket after completion.
Marta: uploading runbook draft to evidence bucket now: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/runbooks/runbook-v1.md (will mark as draft).
security-bot: File upload detected: runbook-v1.md by Marta (2026-03-19 02:15 UTC).
Nina: I'll verify logs after backfill and confirm coverage for 2026-02-14 -> 2026-02-16.
Kevin: uploaded CSV sample (kms-exports-20260214-20260216.csv) and ACL screenshot: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/logs/samples/. Posting links in checklist.
Linh: owners recap for clarity: Marta — runbook, Kevin — logs + retention proof, Sam — pipeline fix, ops-oncall — backfill, Nina — verification. I'll update the Confluence checklist and ping auditors with current status. Please comment here when items are linked in the checklist. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Checklist status changed: 3/6 items marked in-progress, backend evidence bucket entries detected.
Marta: runbook draft added and linked in checklist. Marking owner field.
Nina: backfill validation complete, logs for missing window present. Verified hashes match expected.
Linh: thanks everyone — closing this thread once the vendor attestation letter is added or we have a vendor ETA in the checklist. If anything slips, ping me directly.
